candidates.limits: Keyboard-handler registration ordering, actual focused target and modal lifecycle must be established in an isolated actual-component fixture. No live credential, payment or API calls executed.
candidates.safeNextProof: Actual PaymentModal/native controls with synthetic ConfirmPassword state and captured validatePaymentPassword callback. Verify own input/Confirm/Cancel target and loading Enter/Space, repeated events, other modal owner. Never real payment/account transport.

candidates.claim: Local payment handler has amount/balance checks but no loading guard. Button receives isLoading without disabled; shared Button native interactive guard excludes loading. CSS pointer-events:none mitigates pointer clicks but does not disable keyboard activation. Downstream action marks pending without prior pending guard.
candidates.limits: No actual re-entry or real payment proved by source alone. Exact native button focus and local action counts needed in isolated actual-component fixture.
candidates.safeNextProof: Actual StarsPaymentModal/shared Button with synthetic invoice/balance and captured sendStarPaymentForm callback; first click sets loading, then focused Enter/Space must not increment. No real network/account/payment mutation.
